# Cox

## Feature sources

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `feature_sources` | `List[SpatialBiologyToolkit.config.models.CoxFeatureSourceConfig]` | `[]` | `basic` | AnnData observation sources combined into one case-level feature matrix. | Use distinct names such as nimbus and hyperstac; one source may sweep matching Leiden columns. |

## Clinical metadata

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `clinical_adata_path` | `Optional[str]` | `null` | `basic` | Optional AnnData whose obs supplies case/ROI outcomes and clinical covariates. | - |
| `clinical_csv_path` | `Optional[str]` | `null` | `basic` | Optional CSV supplying case/ROI outcomes and clinical covariates. | Configure exactly one clinical source unless every feature AnnData already contains outcomes. |
| `case_col` | `str` | `Case` | `basic` | Case identifier in clinical metadata. | - |
| `roi_col` | `Optional[str]` | `ROI` | `basic` | ROI identifier used to map feature observations to cases. | - |
| `duration_col` | `str` | `duration` | `basic` | Positive survival or follow-up duration column. | - |
| `event_col` | `Optional[str]` | `event` | `basic` | Event indicator column; null requires assume_all_events or censored_case_ids. | - |
| `covariate_cols` | `List[str]` | `[]` | `basic` | Clinical covariates encoded and compared with image-derived feature sets. | Configure fields such as age and sex to enable clinical-only and combined comparisons. |
| `censored_case_ids` | `List[str]` | `[]` | `advanced` | Cases forced to event=0 when a usable event column is unavailable. | - |
| `assume_all_events` | `bool` | `False` | `advanced` | Treat every case as an observed event when no event column is supplied. | Enable only when censoring is genuinely absent. |
| `metadata_conflict` | `Literal['error', 'first', 'mode']` | `mode` | `advanced` | Resolution policy for repeated non-null case metadata values. | - |

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `min_observations_per_case` | `int` | `1` | `advanced` | Minimum source observations required per case. | - |

| `min_feature_prevalence` | `float` | `0.0` | `advanced` | Minimum fraction of cases with a non-zero feature value. | - |

## Models

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `coxph_max_features` | `int` | `20` | `advanced` | Maximum selected features in the conventional Cox PH model. | - |
| `ridge_max_features` | `int` | `30` | `advanced` | Maximum selected image features in Ridge Cox. | - |
| `models` | `List[Literal['coxph', 'ridge', 'coxnet']]` | `['coxph', 'ridge', 'coxnet']` | `basic` | Cox model families fitted and compared. | - |
| `feature_sets` | `List[Literal['image', 'clinical', 'clinical_image']]` | `['image', 'clinical', 'clinical_image']` | `basic` | Image/clinical feature combinations compared with held-out validation. | - |
| `standardize` | `bool` | `True` | `advanced` | Standardize numeric features within every fit and training fold. | - |
| `coxph_penalizer` | `float` | `0.1` | `advanced` | L2 penalizer for conventional lifelines Cox PH. | - |
| `ridge_alphas` | `List[float]` | `[0.01, 0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0, 3.0, 10.0, 30.0, 100.0]` | `advanced` | Candidate Ridge Cox alpha values evaluated by cross-validation. | - |
| `ridge_fixed_alpha` | `float` | `1.0` | `advanced` | Ridge alpha used for feature-set comparisons when alpha scanning is not requested. | - |
| `coxnet_l1_ratio` | `float` | `1.0` | `advanced` | Elastic-net mixing parameter; one gives the interpretable lasso path used in the notebook. | - |
| `coxnet_n_alphas` | `int` | `200` | `advanced` | Number of CoxNet regularization values. | - |
| `coxnet_alpha_min_ratio` | `float` | `0.001` | `advanced` | Minimum-to-maximum CoxNet alpha ratio. | - |
| `coxnet_max_iter` | `int` | `100000` | `advanced` | Maximum CoxNet solver iterations. | - |
| `coxnet_tolerance` | `float` | `1e-07` | `advanced` | CoxNet convergence tolerance. | - |
